[![PanzaUI logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/main/Images/panzaui_logo.jpeg)](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI)

## PanzaUI

🎮 World of Warcraft custom UI

PanzaUI is a UI for **World of Warcraft Retail** (Midnight) and **WoW Forever** that keeps the default Blizzard interface and fixes what I don't like in it: different textures between the bars of different panels, different borders, inconsistent text formats and so on. On top of that, it brings in features I used to get from other addons.

__WoW Forever__: PanzaUI supports WoW Forever too, with the same modules and options. The few features tied to Retail content are hidden there: the Skyriding visibility of the bars, the Mythic+ rating and keystone, the Auction House expansion filter and the `/rd` and `/pl` shortcuts. Forever support is new: if something doesn't look right, please [open an issue](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/issues).

Since version 2.0 the heart of the UI is the **PanzaUI addon**. It does not replace Blizzard's frames: it restyles them after they are drawn, so Edit Mode and every Blizzard feature keep working as usual. Every feature has its own toggle. Together with a few profiles (Edit Mode layout, Platynator nameplates and, if you want, BigWigs), imported with one click from the options, it recreates the whole PanzaUI setup.

## Why PanzaUI?

About **1 MB** of memory and about **0.1%** CPU on average. PanzaUI hooks the Blizzard frames already on screen instead of building new ones, with no libraries or frameworks. My previous setup, made of several big addons and profiles (until [1.7-RELEASE](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/releases/tag/1.7)), used about **70-90 MB** and about **15%** CPU on average for the same result.

__Note__: designed for 2560×1440 and 65% UI scale. It works at other resolutions too, with some small adjustments of the frame positions.

The addon is available on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/panzaui) and [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/panzaui), so you can install it and keep it updated with the CurseForge or Wago app.

Found a bug or need help? [Open an issue](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/issues) and I'll help as much as I can.

## Features

All the options are in the game menu: **Options → AddOns → PanzaUI** (or just type `/pui` in chat).

| Section | What it does |
|---|---|
| **General** | Class colors for health bars, an outlined *Refined text* for the whole UI, *Refined borders* for icons, tooltips and pop-ups and custom textures for unit frames, cast bars, Cooldown Manager, Personal Resource Display, Damage Meter and progress bars |
| **Action Bars** | Cleaner buttons (no macro names or keybindings), icon zoom, icons in red when out of range and a visibility option for every bar: always, on mouseover (with a fade in and out), only while Skyriding, never while Skyriding (Retail), only in combat, only out of combat or hidden |
| **Bags & Items** | Optional bag auto-sort, item level on equipment in bags, banks and Character/Inspect panels, icon zoom, auto-repair and auto-sell of junk items |
| **Chat** | Cleaner chat windows, timestamps, clickable web links and no more minor messages (guild message of the day, loot of other players, online/offline and join/leave notices…) |
| **Combat** | Rounded icons for buffs, debuffs, Cooldown Manager and Damage Meter, elapsed time on cast bars, a dynamic Cooldown Manager layout and a cleaner Personal Resource Display, optionally hidden while casting |
| **Party & Raid Frames** | Names without server, health as a percentage, cleaner shields and heal prediction, aggro border and sharper role icons |
| **Quest & Minimap** | Cleaner minimap and Quest Tracker, quest counter in the tracker header and a Quest Tracker that hides itself during boss fights, Mythic+ (Retail) and instance combat |
| **Tooltips** | Class colored names, faction, Mythic+ rating (Retail), item level and mount of players, item and spell IDs and an optional anchor to the mouse cursor |
| **Unit Frames** | Refined Player, Target, Focus, Boss and Pet frames: centered names, health and power as a percentage and less clutter (PvP icons, glows, combat text…) |
| **Various** | Cursor ring, Fast Auto Loot, fast item delete, automatic Mythic+ keystone and current expansion filter in the Auction House (Retail), flight path destination, `/way` waypoints, refined Platynator nameplates and BigWigs bars, no more Micro Menu alerts and optionally no error messages |

Want the action bars set up like mine? Check [this guide](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/issues/119).

Handy chat commands: `/pui` (options), `/rl` (reload the UI), `/rd` (ready check, Retail) and `/pl` (10-second pull timer, Retail).

## Support

I'll maintain it as long as I play the game — and considering I've been playing since 2004 (yeah, original Vanilla launch window), that's not changing anytime soon. This UI is in it for the long haul. If you enjoy the UI and want to offer me a beer, be my guest! But if not, that's totally cool too, the UI remains free for everyone, always.

[![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/V4D020XOPV)

## Required Addons

| Addon | Description |
|---|---|
| PanzaUI ([CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/panzaui), [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/panzaui)) | Core addon: improves the default UI with all the features listed above |
| [Platynator](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/platynator) | Customizes enemy and friendly nameplates |

To replicate this setup, follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/blob/main/HOW_TO_INSTALL.md): it explains every step.

## Optional Addons

| Addon | Description |
|---|---|
| [BigWigs](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bigwigs) | Boss encounter alerts and timers (a PanzaUI profile is included) |
| [DialogueUI](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/dialogueui) | Skins the quest and dialogue UI |
| [Plumber](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/plumber) | A collection of quality-of-life features |

## AI Disclaimer

PanzaUI is designed, tested in game and maintained by me. During development I used an AI assistant to help write and review the code, track down bugs and improve performance. Every change has been checked and tested in game before being released.

## Problems/Bugs?

If you find bugs or any kind of problems, please open an issue [here](https://github.com/MarioCatuogno/PanzaUI/issues). Thanks!

releases.name: 2.7-RELEASE
releases.notes:
## 2.7-RELEASE

This updates applies some fixes and many performance improvements.

### 🛠️ Core

* Core - Changed the code to use only the game's current functions and frames, removing the leftover fallbacks for older game versions
* Core - Changed the import profiles to keep in memory only those of the running game version
* Core - Changed the visibility options to skip the Skyriding checks on WoW Forever
* General - Added the Interface Bars texture to the bars of the Skills panel on WoW Forever
* Tooltips - Changed the player tooltips to do less work each time they are shown

### 👤 Profile

* BlizzUI - Fixed Micro Menu position

### 📏 Various

* Updated documentation to the latest UI version

releases.name: 2.6-RELEASE
releases.notes:
## 2.6-RELEASE

This update adds some new modules to Blizzard default profile and fixes some bugs.

### 🛠️ Core

* Chat - Changed the chat channels back to their full names, and their notices (eg. joining or leaving a channel) are shown again
* Combat - Fixed the Refined style of the Damage Meter not applied on WoW Forever
* General - Fixed the texture of the standing bar in the reputation details on WoW Forever
* Unit Frames - Fixed the health bar of the rare and elite Target frame not reaching the portrait on WoW Forever, with the Refined style
* Unit Frames - Fixed the position of the power text of the Player frame on WoW Forever, with the Refined style
* Various - Fixed the Platynator aura icons not styled by the Refined style on WoW Forever

### 👤 Profile

* BigWigs - Added the support for WoW Forever
* BlizzUI - Enabled Cooldown Manager frame
* BlizzUI - Enabled Damage Meter frame
* BlizzUI - Enabled Totem Bar frame
* BlizzUI - Fixed Quest Tracker position
* Platynator - Fixed health bar texture

### 📏 Various

* Updated documentation to the latest UI version
* Updated TOC file to latest version of WoW Retail and WoW Forever

releases.name: 2.5-RELEASE
releases.notes:
## 2.5-RELEASE

This update brings support to WoW Forever and fixes some small bugs from previous version.

### 🛠️ Core

* Action Bars - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Bags & Items - Added an option to sort the bags each time you open them [#141]
* Chat - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Combat - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Combat - Fixed the red interrupt glow staying on the cast bars after an interrupted cast, with the Refined style
* Core - Changed the structure of the addon files (Core, Modules and Profiles per game version) to support both Retail and Forever [#124]
* Core - Fixed the capitalization of some options
* Core - Fixed the error when typing /pui in combat, the options now open after combat
* Core - Improved the error handling: an error in one part of a module no longer stops the other parts, and events missing in a game version are skipped
* Core - Improved the memory cleanup after closing the PanzaUI options
* General - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* General - Fixed an error when showing the progress bars of some tooltips, eg. the Paragon rewards
* General - Fixed the texture of the reputation bars in the Reputation tab on WoW Forever [#124]
* Optimized the code to work on both WoW Retail and WoW Forever [#124]
* Quest & Minimap - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Quest & Minimap - Fixed the calendar button on the Minimap being transparent on WoW Forever [#124]
* Tooltips - Added an option to anchor the tooltips to the mouse cursor [#137]
* Tooltips - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Tooltips - Changed the description of the Player info option on WoW Forever, where there is no Mythic+ rating
* Unit Frames - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Unit Frames - Fixed the level of the Player and Target frames being hidden by the Refined style on WoW Forever
* Unit Frames - Fixed the position of the names of the Player, Target and Focus frames on WoW Forever [#124]
* Various - Added an option to hide the error messages [#138]

### 🧮 Class CDM

* Monk - Brewmaster: Added Combat Potion to Tracked buffs

### 👤 Profile

* BlizzUI - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]
* Platynator - Added the support for WoW Forever [#124]

### 📏 Various

* Updated documentation to the latest UI version

releases.name: 2.4-RELEASE
releases.notes:
## 2.4-RELEASE

This update brings new visibility options for the action bars, a few new skins and some fixes for patch 12.1.5.

### 🛠️ Core

* Action Bars - Added a fade in and fade out to the bars shown on mouseover [#132]
* Action Bars - Added the In Combat and Out of Combat visibility options [#128]
* Action Bars - Fixed the order of the visibility options
* Bags & Items - Fixed the error after the auto-repair at merchants with patch 12.1.5 [#135]
* Combat - Added an option to hide the Personal Resource Display while casting, before part of the Refined style [#131]
* Core - Added the breath and fatigue bars (eg. underwater) to the Interface bars texture
* Core - Fixed the Refined borders option on the Group Finder queue status (eye tooltip), now with the new border texture [#130]
* Core - Fixed the Cast Bars texture missing on some casts of the Boss frames (eg. during an encounter), now always applied
* Core - Fixed the Refined borders option on the reagent selection of professions (eg. finishing reagents), now with the new border texture and the action bar style on the icons
* Core - Fixed the decimals on the power bars percentage, now shown only on the health bars

### 🧮 Class CDM

* Druid - Feral: Added Combat Potion to Tracked buffs
* Monk - Brewmaster: Added Combat Potion to Tracked buffs
* Monk - Windwalker: Added Combat Potion to Tracked buffs

### 👤 Profiles

* BigWigs - Adjusted the position of BigWigs bars [#134]
* BigWigs - Fixed text style of BigWigs M+ alerts
* BlizzUI - Adjusted the position of Focus frame to better show BigWigs bars [#134]
* BlizzUI - Fixed the position of Chat frame to show Voice Chat overlay
* BlizzUI - Fixed the position of Quest Tracker to avoid conflict with some quest panels introduced with patch 12.1.5 [#135]
* BlizzUI - Switched position of Pet bar and Stance bar

### 📏 Various

* Updated documentation to the latest UI version
* Updated TOC file to patch version 12.1.5

releases.name: 2.3-RELEASE
releases.notes:
## 2.3-RELEASE

This is a smaller update focused on fixing a lot of small bugs and adding some new features.

### 🛠️ Core

* Action Bars - Added an option to color the action button icons red when out of range [#127]
* Chat - Fixed the copy box of web links opening twice with a single click
* Chat - Hidden the Edit Mode layout copied to clipboard notice, with the Hide clutter option
* Combat - Fixed the Buffs & Debuffs Refined style on the loss of control alert icon (eg. Rooted), now in the action bar style
* Core - Changed the ready check command from /rc to /rd
* Core - Fixed the Cast Bars texture missing on the overlay cast bar (eg. "Activating Specialization" in the talents panel)
* Core - Fixed the Refined borders option on the Delves Companion panel and abilities, now with the new border texture and the action bar style on the icons
* Core - Fixed the Refined borders option on the icons of the Collections mounts, sets and set items, now in the action bar style (in the item quality color)
* Core - Fixed the Refined borders option on the Great Vault rewards, now with the action bar style on the icons and the new border texture on the item names (in the item quality color)
* Core - Fixed the Refined borders option on the ready check window, now with the Blizzard frame (the border covered the portrait)
* Core - Fixed the Refined text on the dark texts of the Mythic+ New Season panel, now shown without the outline
* Core - Fixed the Refined text on the profession names of the Professions book, now outlined
* Core - Fixed the position of the texts on the achievement bars with the Interface bars texture, now centered
* Core - Fixed the small gap in the top corners between the icons and their border, with the Refined borders option
* Core - Improved the descriptions of all the options, now clear and concise (eg. "Hide system notices" is now "Hide micro menu alerts")
* Core - Optimized the code with shared helpers for icons, borders, frame pools, events and panel updates, for a lighter and more consistent addon
* Core - Optimized the scan of panels and fonts, now done without temporary tables
* Party & Raid Frames - Changed the size of the sharper role icons, now the same as the name
* Quest & Minimap - Added a Refined style option for the Quest Tracker, without the All Objectives header and with the quest count on the Quests header
* Quest & Minimap - Fixed the clock text size with the minimap Refined style, now the same as the zone name
* Tooltips - Added the faction of players in red (Horde) or blue (Alliance) to the Refined style
* Unit Frames - Changed the number of debuffs shown on the Focus frame with the Refined style, now 5
* Various - Added an option to insert the Mythic+ keystone automatically when opening the Font of Power
* Various - Fixed the BigWigs Refined style on the start timer bar (eg. battlegrounds), now with the same border as the queue timer

### 👤 Profiles

* BigWigs - Fixed bars position to be aligned to the Focus frame
* BlizzUI - Fixed the position of Action Bar 3
* Platynator - Fixed the Cast bar border texture
* Platynator - Fixed the width of Enemy names

### 📏 Various

* Updated documentation to the latest UI version
